newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton markets quiet, prices steady.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton markets quiet, prices steady.

text.p: Prices for raw cotton in European markets were unchanged in dull trade, industry sources said.
Regular buyers remained aloof with no fresh incentives to tempt them to market, although Belgium saw more active enquiry on Wednesday.
Trading continues to focus on December shipment and for delivery early in 1997, sources said.
Some sources said Central Asian cottons were particularly affected by this trend as fears that future supplies could prove irregular have moved a few buyers to cover their basic requirements.
